title: Cliqo — Find Trusted Service Providers
summary: A web and mobile marketplace that helps people find trusted service providers — "Whatever you need… just Cliq it."
role: Solo project — designed and built end to end.
overview: Cliqo connects customers with trusted service providers. Customers sign up, find professionals for the job they need done and pay securely in the app, on the web or on their phone. It has an owner admin area with sub-admin roles for helpers.

features.title: Find trusted providers
features.text: Browse and find professionals for a service need.

features.title: Secure payments
features.text: In-app payments through Paystack.

features.title: Admin & sub-admins
features.text: Owner admin area with sub-admin roles for helpers.

features.title: Web and mobile
features.text: Runs in the browser, with an Android app downloadable from the website.

challenges: Deploying on free tiers without a card: frontend on Cloudflare, backend on Railway and the database on Neon, on the custom domain cliqo.com.ng.

title: Cliqo Health — Remote Consultation Platform
summary: A web and mobile platform for free or low-cost remote consultation, test-result explanation and therapy with verified Nigerian health workers.
role: Solo project: product design and development.
overview: Cliqo Health connects patients with verified providers for remote consultation, advice, test-result interpretation and therapy. It doesn't handle physical treatment. Providers register with proof of their profession and agree to near-free rates. Patients get free credits on sign-up, then pay as they go, and the patient and provider agree on how to meet: chat, voice, video or group therapy. Motto: "By the Ummah, For the Ummah."

features.title: Verified health workers
features.text: Doctors, nurses, pharmacists, therapists and others register with proof of licence; new professions can be added at sign-up.

features.title: Flexible consultations
features.text: Chat, voice call, video or group sessions, chosen by patient and health worker together.

features.title: Free credits
features.text: 10 free credits on sign-up, then small pay-as-you-go top-ups with a 5% platform fee.

features.title: Local languages
features.text: Interface available in English and Nigerian Pidgin.

challenges: Splitting hosting across free tiers: API on Railway, database on Neon, the web app as a Cloudflare Worker, and uploaded files moved to Cloudflare R2.

title: CliqoCheck — App Activity Tracker
summary: A native Android app that shows which apps have been opened on a phone, with timestamps, plus a premium App Lock with intruder selfie.
role: Solo project: designed, built, launched and monetised it.
overview: CliqoCheck reads Android's own usage history to show which apps were opened and when. It's free to use, with a one-time premium unlock (paid in-app via Paystack) for App Lock: lock any app behind a PIN, and a wrong PIN snaps a selfie of whoever tried. It's publicly launched and distributed as a signed APK from its own download page.

features.title: App activity history
features.text: See which apps were opened on the phone, with timestamps.

features.title: App Lock + intruder selfie
features.text: Lock apps behind a PIN; a wrong PIN takes a selfie.

features.title: In-app payments
features.text: One-time premium unlock via Paystack (card, transfer or USSD), unlocked instantly.

features.title: Cloud-built releases
features.text: Signed APKs built automatically with GitHub Actions.

title: SiteLedger — Fuel & Asset Operations Platform
summary: A fuel and asset operations platform for Nigerian industrial sites — generators, tanks and deliveries — with a reconciliation engine that flags fuel variance and possible leakage.
role: Started as Backend Developer on the Full Stack team of a four-track capstone (Full Stack, Data Analytics, Cloud, Machine Learning) under the NCDMB Digitalization Initiative, then took over the frontend as well.
overview: SiteLedger helps operators track fuel deliveries, tank dips and assets across multiple sites, then reconciles what was delivered against what was used to spot variances, such as fuel theft, early. I built the Flask backend (models, REST APIs, authentication and role-based access, and the maintenance and compliance module) and later took on the frontend too.

features.title: Auth & role-based access
features.text: Login, roles and per-site access scoping so users only see the sites they manage.

features.title: Fuel & asset APIs
features.text: REST endpoints for deliveries, dips, suppliers, generators, tanks and other site assets.

features.title: Variance & dashboard endpoints
features.text: Exposes the Data team's Postgres reconciliation results and leaderboard to the frontend.

features.title: Maintenance & compliance
features.text: Maintenance logs and schedules, compliance checklists, incident logging and automatic reminder notifications.

challenges: Aligning the backend models with a database schema owned by another team, moving from local SQLite to a shared cloud Postgres database without losing data, and deploying the API to Vercel on a custom subdomain.

title: CheckAm — Fake Product Checker for NAFDAC
summary: A prototype that lets Nigerians check foods, drinks and drugs in seconds, and sends every suspected fake straight to NAFDAC.
role: Solo project: concept, design and prototype, prepared as a pilot to pitch to NAFDAC.
overview: Fake foods, drinks and drugs are a serious problem in Nigeria. CheckAm lets a shopper scan a product's barcode or QR code, type its NAFDAC number or scratch PIN, or photograph the pack for an AI check, and tag where they bought it. When a product looks fake, the report appears on the NAFDAC desk immediately, on every device that has it open. The prototype runs on invented sample data.

features.title: Scan or type a code
features.text: Barcode, QR code, NAFDAC number or scratch PIN.

features.title: AI pack inspection
features.text: Photograph the pack and AI looks for signs of a fake.

features.title: Instant NAFDAC alerts
features.text: Suspected fakes, with location and market, appear live on the NAFDAC desk.

features.title: Four views
features.text: Shopper app, NAFDAC desk, manufacturer and pharmacy/trader views, with language options.

title: Oil & Gas Compliance Management Platform
summary: A Python desktop application for managing oil & gas equipment, maintenance schedules, vendor comparison, regulatory news, compliance automation and analytics.
overview: This application was designed to improve operational efficiency by providing an integrated platform for managing oil and gas equipment, maintenance schedules, vendor information, regulatory news, compliance reports and weather advisories.

features.title: Equipment Management
features.text: Register, update and monitor oil & gas equipment.

features.title: Maintenance Scheduling
features.text: Record maintenance history and monitor equipment health.

features.title: Vendor Comparison
features.text: Compare equipment prices from multiple vendors.

features.title: Regulatory News
features.text: Automatically retrieves the latest industry news and updates.

features.title: Weather Advisory
features.text: Displays weather conditions affecting field operations.

features.title: Analytics Dashboard
features.text: Visualize maintenance trends and equipment performance.

challenges: Managing persistent data with CSV files, integrating live regulatory news and weather information, automating web data retrieval, generating analytical charts, and packaging the application into a standalone Windows executable for distribution.

title: PrepBridge — Exam Prep Platform
summary: An edtech platform for Nigerian secondary school students that combines a WAEC, NECO and JAMB past-questions library with a marketplace for finding tutors.
role: Founder — product definition, design and development.
overview: PrepBridge is built for three kinds of users: students preparing for exams, tutors and teachers, and parents. It pairs a searchable past-questions bank with a two-sided tutor marketplace, across web and mobile.

features.title: Past-questions library
features.text: WAEC, NECO and JAMB questions in one place.

features.title: Tutor marketplace
features.text: Students and parents find and book tutors; tutors find students.

features.title: Built for three personas
features.text: Separate journeys for students, tutors and parents.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
summary: This website — a responsive Flask portfolio where every project is stored as data, with a working contact form.
overview: Built with Flask and Jinja templates on Bootstrap. Projects, skills and profile details are stored in JSON files, so new work is added without touching the HTML, and the contact form validates input, filters spam and delivers messages by email.

features.title: Data-driven content
features.text: Projects and profile details live in JSON files.

features.title: Working contact form
features.text: Validation, spam protection and email delivery.

features.title: Responsive & shareable
features.text: Mobile-friendly layout with link previews for LinkedIn and WhatsApp.

title: MASQ Mobile Prototype
summary: A mobile application prototype focused on intuitive UI/UX, user-friendly navigation and clean layouts.
overview: A mobile application prototype demonstrating intuitive UI/UX design, user-friendly navigation and clean layouts.
